name: Ignitemare
look: a gaunt shadow horse with white ribs and spine showing, a bare horse skull with glowing red eyes and short black-tipped horns, fire snorting from its nostrils, bone-armoured legs split by glowing cracks and huge hooked claw-hooves
entry: When the CobbleEffort Mudbray's sulking turns to rage, its body burns away to a shadow round its bones. It gallops through badlands at night, snorting fire, and its hollow skull glows red with the grudges it refuses to let go.
how: Evolve the CobbleEffort Mudbray at level 30. It learns Flame Charge when it evolves.
